description: Job listings from XING (Germany, Austria, Switzerland) for a keyword and optional location: title, company, location, employment type, salary band as shown by XING (EUR), posting time (ISO, when XING shows it), whether it is an external partner ad, and job URL, plus the number of matching jobs XING reports (capped at 999 by XING). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
